value.rationale: Euclidean-area sampling on a whole bounded invariant sublevel defines a stationary invariant probability measure for this divergence-free Hamiltonian global center, unlike an unmotivated parameter slice. The theorem gives an exact finite-ensemble distribution, identifies Pareto rather than concentrated typical periods, and computes its otherwise divergent finite-size mean with exact coefficient 1/3. These quantify the disparity between typical orbit and spatial average, not merely recompute a known elliptic period.
